generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: Two open semantic classes are separated by finite literals or stems and an unchecked default decides unseen members.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Enumerate all observed fixtures and use default acceptance or rejection for any unseen member outside the finite vocabulary.
trigger_signals: both semantic classes are open or unbounded
production uses finite literal, stem, regex or catalog discriminators
a default branch decides unknown members
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Require withheld positive and negative members outside production literals and prove a transferable decision at the real boundary.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Independently generate withheld members on both sides, scan the production discriminator for literal leakage and execute the real boundary.
